title: Koopman Operator Framework for Modeling and Control of Off-Road Vehicle on Deformable Terrain
summary: This work presents a hybrid physics-informed and data-driven modeling framework for predictive control of autonomous off-road vehicles operating on deformable terrain. Traditional high-fidelity terramechanics models are often too computationally demanding to be directly used in control design. Modern Koopman operator methods can be used to represent the complex terramechanics and vehicle dynamics in a linear form.
